title: Manage your land tax with a MyServiceNSW Account – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for managing your land tax using a MyServiceNSW Account.
who_can_apply: You have received a Land Tax Notice of Assessment or recent correspondence.
You have a Client ID (found on the Land Tax Notice of Assessment or recent correspondence) to connect your MyServiceNSW Account with RNSW's online services.
what_you_need: A Land Tax Notice of Assessment or recent correspondence.
A Client ID (found on the Land Tax Notice of Assessment or recent correspondence).
